channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Planet trapped record heat in 2025: UN - World News
item.description: The amount of heat trapped by the Earth reached record levels in 2025, with the consequences of such warming feared to last for thousands of years, the UN warned Monday.

item.title: Stocks tumble, oil rises as Trump gives Iran 48-hour ultimatum - Latest News
item.description: Stocks tumbled Monday and oil prices jumped after Donald Trump and Iranian leaders traded threats over the key Strait of Hormuz, while Israel said the Middle East war could last several more weeks.

item.title: New models drive momentum in Türkiye’s auto industry - Latest News
item.description: Türkiye’s automotive sector is stepping into a vibrant new chapter in 2025, with legacy manufacturers launching fresh models and new competitors entering the scene.

item.title: Iran crisis poses new challenges to Turkish agriculture - Latest News
item.description: Türkiye’s agricultural sector, which is already grappling with drought, frost and rising input costs, now faces a fresh blow as disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz threaten fertilizer shipments.

item.title: Turkish tax authority targets wealthy non-filers - Latest News
item.description: The Treasury and Finance Ministry’s Tax Inspection Board (VDK) is set to issue notices to 16,300 high-income taxpayers who failed to file income declarations despite lavish spending patterns.

item.title: Türkiye’s intel chief meets Hamas team - Türkiye News
item.description: Turkish National Intelligence Organization (MİT) chief İbrahim Kalın on March 22 met with the representatives of Hamas to discuss the implementation of the Gaza peace deal amid continued Israeli attacks on civilians, security sources have said.

item.title: 1 dead after gas explosion collapses 2 buildings in Istanbul - Türkiye News
item.description: A natural gas explosion in Istanbul’s central Fatih district caused the collapse of two buildings on March 22, leaving one person dead and 10 others injured, officials have informed.

item.title: Oil prices plunge over 10 pct on Trump's Iran remarks - Latest News
item.description: Oil prices tumbled on Monday after U.S. President Donald Trump said the U.S. was postponing strikes on Iranian power plants and energy infrastructure after "very good" talks with Iran.

item.title: Ara Güler ‘Mastering the Image’ opens in France
item.description: Photojournalist Ara Güler, celebrated as the “Eye of Istanbul,” is crossing borders to mesmerize France with his timeless photographs in his exhibition “Mastering the Image.”

item.title: Iran, US send mixed signals as strikes show no slowdown - World News
item.description: Tehran and Washington on March 24 continued to give mixed signals over the talks to end the war in Iran, after hopes rose that the conflict could begin winding down despite attacks.

item.title: Turkish FM intensifies diplomatic push to broker peace - Türkiye News
item.description: Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan has continued his engagements with prominent actors to put an end to the ongoing war in the Middle East, Turkish diplomatic sources have said.

item.title: Israel pounds south Beirut, says captured Hezbollah members - World News
item.description: A series of strikes hit Beirut's southern suburbs on Monday and early Tuesday, the first attack on the Hezbollah stronghold in days, as Israel's military said it captured two members of the Iran-backed group in southern Lebanon.

item.title: Solar power surges 641-fold in Türkiye’s clean energy drive - Latest News
item.description: Türkiye has witnessed a remarkable transformation in its electricity generation portfolio over the past twelve years, with solar energy emerging as one of the most dynamic contributors.

item.title: Russian barrage hits homes across Ukraine, killing 5 - World News
item.description: A barrage of Russian missiles and drones killed five people and wounded more than two dozen across Ukraine on Tuesday in the largest attack in weeks, officials said.

item.title: Türkiye moves to ban household waste oil disposal - Türkiye News
item.description: Türkiye is stepping up efforts to protect its environment ahead of hosting the UN Climate Change Conference COP31, targeting household waste management as part of its broader sustainability agenda.
